traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are met: - REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE: normalizeCommentLine removes backtick-wrapped segments using /`[^`]*`/g and tests confirm @story/@req/@supports inside backticks are ignored. - REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES: removed segments are replaced with spaces of equal length; tests assert exact expected strings with preserved spacing. - REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER & IMPL-NORMALIZE-COMMENT: filtering is implemented in the shared helper normalizeCommentLine in valid-annotation-format-internal.ts, which is used by the rule logic. - Common documentation patterns (e.g. '`@story` + `@req`', 'using `@supports`') do not produce detectable annotations in tests. - Real annotations outside backticks are still detected and normalized to begin at the @story token. - Behavior applies per-line and integrates with existing multi-line comment handling; no regressions are indicated, as the full Jest suite (44 suites, 330 tests) passes. - Documentation describing inline-code filtering is present in the JSDoc for normalizeCommentLine and the story file, and tests are explicitly linked to this story and its requirements.
